name: PMC property tax
title: Pune Municipal Corporation property tax: latest rules and changes
summary: The property tax the Pune Municipal Corporation charges homes, how new homes are registered for it, and the penalties it adds.
means: A new home must be registered for property tax before the first bill. Ask the builder who files it and from which date the tax runs, and keep the assessment receipt.

history.status: The Pune Municipal Corporation will levy extra property tax on developers of illegal constructions, to recover what demolishing them costs.
New property tax registrations have fallen well behind this year because the department is short of staff; the corporation also adds a penalty tax on developers of illegal constructions.
